'''Turbolaser tower T31-S11''' was a [[Turbolaser/Legends|tubolaser]] tower located in zone [[S11]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], between the [[Equatorial trench/Legends|Equatorial Trench]] and the southern [[Mid-Hemisphere Trench (South)|Mid-Hemisphere Trench]].<ref name="TPotF" /> It was destroyed along with the rest of the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC" />
